subject: Post-call: BrightCart trial readiness & traffic evaluation schedule
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@brightcart.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: BrightCart trial readiness & traffic evaluation schedule

Hi Lena / Marco —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the next steps for the 2-week trial so we can kick off engineering early next week. Key points below and a few clarifying questions where we need numbers from you.

Summary of what we heard from BrightCart
- Primary use-case: user-facing summarization & product-recommendation assistant on checkout flows (high-value paths).
- Target endpoints: "recommendation" (short prompts, high QPS) and "order-summary" (longer context, lower QPS).
- Go/no-go criteria: P95 generative latency under 400ms for the recommendation endpoint at expected trial load; no data retention beyond session; no PII forwarded to external services.

Traffic / workload ask (please confirm these values):
- Baseline RPS (sustained): ~40 requests/sec across both endpoints combined.
- Expected concurrency (simultaneous active sessions): 60 concurrent sessions at peak.
- Average prompt tokens: 120 tokens (recommendation: ~60; summary: ~220).
- Average completion tokens: 180 tokens (recommendation short completion; summary longer).
- Burst pattern: anticipated hourly bursts where recommendation endpoint spikes to ~400 RPS for 1–3 minutes (campaign / flash sale), 3–5x baseline.
- KV / prefix reuse: ~70% prefix reuse expected for recommendation flows (same product slate).

Action items / timeline (proposed)
- Today (Sat): you send the completed traffic_profile template — fields: per-endpoint RPS distribution, max token lengths, auth flow, sample prompts.
- Mon 12/14: Redwood prepares a scoped dedicated pool config and runbook; we schedule a short sync (30m) to agree final thresholds and rollout window.
- Tue 12/15: Trial begins (2 weeks). Daily check-ins on days 1–3, then every 3 days.

Owners
- Redwood: Sergio (trial owner / escalation), Marissa (SRE lead for runbook), Ben (customer success / billing).
- BrightCart: Lena (product), Marco (SRE).

Attachments: I attached our MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN and the traffic_profile template. Please send the filled traffic_profile by EOD Mon so we can lock infra config.

If anything above is off, call it out and we’ll adjust.

Thanks —
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0146

Thanks Sergio —

Filling in the traffic profile now. Quick clarifications inline:

- Baseline RPS: 35 RPS (we trimmed the earlier estimate after weekday/holiday adjustments).
- Peak bursts: correct — we have marketing-triggered spikes up to ~420 RPS for ~2 minutes, roughly every 45–90 minutes during promotions.
- Average prompt tokens: 95 tokens (recommendation), 260 tokens (summary). Completion tokens: ~150 (recommendation), ~300 (summary).
- Max token ceiling: 2,048 tokens for summary flows (rare).
- KV reuse: closer to 60% across recommendation flows.

We'll upload brightcart_traffic_profile_filled.xlsx to the Drive link you shared by Monday EOD PST. Also attaching a short note on our security requirements (no external logging of full session).

Agreeing to owners and adding notes from an SRE perspective.

Feasibility (summary):
- Recommendation endpoint: yes, feasible to hit P95 < 400ms for the trial with the numbers provided, with the following caveats:
  - We need burst mitigation (burst buffer + autoscale) to handle 420 RPS short spikes; continuous 420 RPS sustained will require more capacity than typical trial allowance.
  - Recommend enabling KV prefix caching and a small L1 prefix cache per worker to get to the 60–70% reuse Lena mentioned.
  - Use a quantized model variant for recommendation endpoint (v-reco-q4) during burst windows to conserve GPU cycles.

Estimated readiness: we can provision and smoke-test a scoped environment by Tue 2026-12-15 18:00 UTC if we get the completed traffic_profile by EOD Mon PST and confirm access to their VPC/auth endpoint.

Runbook links / deliverables:
- I uploaded a draft runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/brightcart/poc/runbook-draft
- I'll attach the SOW and mutual action plan to the trial workspace once Sergio signs off (see attached SOW stub).
